# Badge, Badge-Counter & Badge-Status

**Figma:** Badge, Badge-Counter, Badge-Status + .Primitives/Badge/Progress-Icon (page 239:18960)  
**Import:** `import { Badge, BadgeCounter, BadgeStatus } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Non-interactive status, category or count labels; BadgeStatus for the steps of a task or project workflow.

## Use it for
- Status in lists (Live, Failed).
- Unread/notification counts (BadgeCounter).
- Removable labels on an item (remove + onRemove).
- A task's or project's workflow step — To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done, Blocked, Cancelled — in tables, boards, detail views and status pickers (BadgeStatus).

## Use something else for
- Selectable filters → Chip.
- Values inside an input → Tag.
- A percentage people read as a number → ProgressBar / ProgressCircle.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Size | `size` | xsmall · small · medium |
| Theme | `theme` | semantic + support colours (18) |
| Background | `background` | solid · subtle |
| Leading-Icon | `leading / leadingIcon` | hidden on xsmall |
| Remove | `remove / onRemove / removeLabel` | icon-x-circle-solid; removeLabel names the button when the label is not text |
| Badge-Status Status | `BadgeStatus status` | to-do (Neutral) · in-progress (Info) · in-review (Warning) · done (Positive) · blocked (Negative, icon-slash-circle-01-line) · cancelled (Neutral, icon-x-circle-line, muted label) |
| Badge-Status Size | `BadgeStatus size` | small (20, ring 16) · medium (28, ring 20) |
| Progress-Icon arc | `BadgeStatus progress` | 0–100; default per step (0 · 25 · 50 · 100); a set value is read after the label ("60% complete") |
| Badge-Status label | `BadgeStatus children` | default from the locale (en "In Progress", vi "Đang làm") |

### BadgeStatus
Figma Badge-Status (16932:195, page ❖ Badge): Status × Size, promoted from the HR-Platform template. A task's or a project's workflow step as a Subtle badge whose ring fills as the work moves on. Built on the Badge tokens (Badge/Size, Badge/Spacing; the ring Element-Size/Popular/Base on Medium, Popular/Small on Small, left padding Spacing/Padding/2XSmall · 3XSmall so the ring is concentric with the pill). Colours per step: Color/Background/`<Tone>`/Subtle/Default, the label Content/`<Tone>`/Strongest, the ring Content/`<Tone>`/Light. Blocked and Cancelled use the library's icon-slash-circle-01-line and icon-x-circle-line. The ring is .Primitives/Badge/Progress-Icon (16943:171).

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "children">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLSpanElement>` | — | The root `<span>`. |
| `status` | `"to-do" \| "in-progress" \| "in-review" \| "done" \| "blocked" \| "cancelled"` | `"to-do"` | The workflow step: to-do (Neutral) · in-progress (Info) · in-review (Warning) · done (Positive) · blocked (Negative) · cancelled (Neutral, muted label). |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "small" \| "medium"` | `"md"` | Short (sm, md) or Figma (small, medium) spelling. Medium is 28 high with a 20px ring, Small 20 with a 16px ring. |
| `progress` | `number` | — | How full the ring is, 0–100 (Figma: the Progress layer's arc). Default: the step's own value (to-do 0, in-progress 25, in-review 50, done 100). Set it for an exact value (a project at 60%); it is then read after the label. Blocked and Cancelled have no ring and ignore it. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | The label. Default: the step's name from the locale's labels (en "In Progress", vi "Đang làm"). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

## ✅ Do
- Map status to semantic themes consistently (green = success, red = failure, yellow = attention).
- Use Subtle backgrounds in dense tables and Solid for emphasis.
- Cap counters at "99+" and hide them at zero.
- Show counts (unread, items, filters applied, a section's or folder's item count) with BadgeCounter (Figma Badge-Counter) — a round pill whose min width equals its height — never a Badge holding a number nor bare text beside a label; keep Badge for words and statuses (harness: badge/count-uses-counter, badge/count-text-uses-counter; component-usage-rules §18).
- Make counts agree with their noun — "1 file" / "3 files" — with a plural helper; never print {list.length} straight before a noun (harness: copy/plural-count).
- Show a workflow step with BadgeStatus, never a Badge themed by hand: the step sets the colour and the ring, so every screen reads one workflow the same way (harness: badge/workflow-status-uses-badge-status).
- Keep one workflow per product, in order: To Do → In Progress → In Review → Done; Blocked and Cancelled sit outside it. Rename a step only by its label (children), never by repainting another step.
- Pass progress only when you know the exact share of the work done (a project at 60%); otherwise the step's own ring says enough.
- Lead a priority badge (Urgent, High, Medium, Low) with the solid flag, leading="icon-flag-03-solid" (Figma .Task/Priority), in the one priority palette: Urgent and High red, Medium yellow, Low neutral — the same everywhere, PropertySelect tones negative / warning / neutral (harness: priority/palette); keep a status badge's leading icon (the dot, or an icon per state) — the user 2026-10-24 (harness: badge/status-priority-icon).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't make a badge clickable (use Chip).
- Don't make a BadgeStatus removable or clickable: a status changes in its picker (a Popover of BadgeStatus items, Input/Property-Field Type=Status).
- Don't rely on colour alone; keep the text.
- Don't hide the icon of a status or priority badge (leadingIcon={false}), and don't leave a Table's status or priority badge column without one (harness: badge/status-priority-icon, table/badge-column-icon).
- Don't use more than two badges on one row item; summarise the rest.
- Don't show counters at zero.

## Accessibility
- The remove button is named "Remove `<label>`" (vi "Xoá `<label>`") from a text label. Pass removeLabel when the label is an icon or other node; without it the button falls back to "Remove".
- BadgeStatus: the ring is decorative and the label carries the step, so colour is never the only cue. With progress set, the value is read after the label ("In Progress, 60% complete").

## Content
- One or two words; no punctuation.
- BadgeStatus labels name the step, not the action ("In Review", not "Review now").

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `removable/needs-handler` | error | A remove affordance must be wired to onRemove. | `zen-allow-remove-handler: <reason>` |
| `badge-counter/cap` | warn | Counters cap at 99+. | `zen-allow-counter-cap: <reason>` |
| `flag/no-emoji-flag` | warn | Country flags are the Flag component (Figma Flag set), not emoji flags: emoji render differently on every OS and Windows shows letters. | `zen-allow-emoji-flag: <reason>` |
| `theme/on-solid-content` | error | Content on a Card theme="solid" takes the fill's family (Figma audit theme/on-solid-content): on Neutral/Solid a Badge or DockIcon is theme="inverse", on Accent and the colour solids theme="on-color"; text and icons keep a neutral tone (the card re-points it to Inverse, On-Accent, On-Brights or On-Colors) or that family's own tone, never a colour tone. | `zen-allow-on-solid-content: <reason>` |
| `badge/count-uses-counter` | error | A bare count (a number, or an expression like count / length / total / unread) is a Badge-Counter, not a Badge — BadgeCounter keeps the round pill and a min width equal to its height. | `zen-allow-badge-count: <reason>` |
| `badge/workflow-status-uses-badge-status` | error | A workflow step (To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done, Blocked, Cancelled; vi Cần làm, Đang làm, Đang duyệt, Hoàn thành, Bị chặn, Đã huỷ) is a BadgeStatus: its ring shows how far the work has moved and the step picks its colours. Other statuses (Live, Paid, Draft) stay Badges. | `zen-allow-badge-workflow-status: <reason>` |
| `badge/status-priority-icon` | warn | A priority badge (Urgent, High, Medium, Low) leads with the solid flag, leading="icon-flag-03-solid" (Figma .Task/Priority); a status badge (Active, Paid, Overdue…) keeps its leading icon: the dot, or an icon per state, never leadingIcon={false}. | `zen-allow-badge-status-icon: <reason>` |
| `priority/palette` | warn | Priority has one palette: Urgent and High red (tone negative), Medium yellow (warning), Low neutral, each led by icon-flag-03-solid; on a Badge (theme) and on PropertySelect options (tone, icon). | `zen-allow-priority-palette: <reason>` |
| `badge/count-text-uses-counter` | error | A count shown on its own beside a label (a section's, a tab's or a filter's item count: an element whose class names a count) is a BadgeCounter, not bare text — the same round pill everywhere a number counts something. | `zen-allow-count-text: <reason>` |
| `api/deprecated-prop` | warn | A deprecated prop still works but has a canonical name (onValueChange, onCheckedChange, checked, selected, level…); apps get a warning with the replacement. (App mode only; the repo migrates gradually.) | `zen-allow-deprecated: <reason>` |
| `api/overrides-studio-only` | error | `overrides` (Figma instance overrides of the layers a component draws itself: `{ "Sub-Action": { level: "danger" } }`) is written by Zen Studio on the pages it makes; hand-written code sets the component's own props or composes the parts (the user's call, 2026-10-10). | `zen-allow-overrides: <reason>` |
| `copy/plural-count` | warn | Counts agree with their noun (1 item · 2 items): build the phrase with a plural helper, never `{list.length} items`. | `zen-allow-plural: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
